pages.text: The Network Transmitter is a crucial component for extending your Refined Storage network across long distances. It sends a network signal to a $(l:receiver)Network Receiver$() specified in the $(l:network_card)Network Card$(). For the Network Transmitter to function, the $(l:control)Controller$() it is connected to must be chunkloaded. This setup allows for seamless integration of distant storage systems. Read $(l:distance)this$() for more details.
